pr_gds_reference.semantics: decode GDS DS_ORDERED_COUNT 64-bit word including index and operation, release/done flags; transactional host batch uses explicit, complete creation sequence and fully evaluated runtime M0, preexisting counter initial values and caller resolved payload. isa_caveat: Legacy GCN and modern RDNA differ in how ordered count inputs are described (EXEC count vs first valid lane, indexed stream out). CPU executor accepts a value evaluated by the *actual target-specific guest frontend*; never infers from static shader SGPR/M0. Need validate pre-GCN3/GCN2 target explicitly.
